inputFilesValue.rows: physical JSONL nonempty row count; null for JSON

manifest.counts: Diagnostic source counts, never hardcoded population requirements; questions excludes actor_kind, allTasks includes every grouping bridge.

baselineRow.features: Five finite doubles in featureOrder; never annotation answers, IDs, rationales or grouping keys.
baselineRow.comparison: Actual policy-free IdentityCandidateMatcher.ComparePeople DTO; camelCase members and snake_case enum strings. CandidateUuid is null because a source mention is not a canonical identity.
baselineRow.projectionSupported: Both original mention_kind values are name.
baselineRow.projectionIssue: null for supported projection; unsupported_mention_expression otherwise.
baselineRow.sameRecording: Exact equality of retained evidence IDs; use this for true cross-recording cohorts rather than taskKind alone.
baselineRow.pool: Every declared candidate is exported, including insufficient labels and unsupported expressions. No answer is copied to this exchange.

trainingJoin.authenticate: Verify pinned bundle/source/labels and baseline manifests, pair hash, artifact hashes, exact edge set, focal ownership, declared pool count and numeric vector against actual comparison.
trainingJoin.groupBeforeFilter: Call the people bundle validator build_split_components on all tasks, including actor_kind and unknown bridges.
trainingJoin.targets: Only resolved same_entity/different_entities with supported projection enter fitting. Insufficient/unsupported remain output, never negatives.
trainingJoin.runtimeMapping: Logistic decision_function raw logits map to existing PeopleAcceptanceLinearScorer fields; no thresholds, margins, attestation, activation or creation are supplied by this exchange.
